protocol.development: 2018-2024 expanding-year folds; tuning uses expanding 2019-2024 folds only
protocol.validation: 2025; first 70% of distinct dates fit calibration, last 30% choose none/Platt/isotonic; final chosen calibrator refit on all 2025
protocol.holdout: Sealed official 2026 snapshot; single final run; online history may update after recorded result availability; no refitting or tuning
protocol.secondary: LCKC/CK, LDL, PCS/LCP/LMS, VCS, CBLOL/LTA S, LJL: ratings only
protocol.selection: minimum pooled development fold log loss; no base-model selection on 2025
protocol.baseline: v6 code unchanged, fixed v6 selected model/settings; re-fit on primary 2018-2024; same reporting games; tuned Elo also development-selected
protocol.series_policy: OE game ordinal and available prior same-day team-pair results; scheduled best-of absent unless explicit pre-game schedule supplied; no inference from final series length
protocol.freeze: Hash source, manifests, input DB, fitted models, calibration, protocol and feature lists before opening holdout. Exclusive single-run claim; no rerun or code changes afterward.

Elo.policy: refit selected calibrator on all 2025 for 2026 only

v6_original_data.policy: refit selected calibrator on all 2025 for 2026 only

v6_expanded_data.policy: refit selected calibrator on all 2025 for 2026 only

v7.policy: refit selected calibrator on all 2025 for 2026 only

limitations: Scheduled best-of absent in OE source: masked unknown; no BO inferred from completed series length.
Series linkage is same-day team pair plus source game ordinal, not an authoritative series ID.
Fearless era flag is a time proxy, not a tournament-specific rule; constant pre-2025, so its effect is not learned.
Glicko-2 player updates approximate the opponent team by mean rating and aggregate deviation; TrueSkill uses actual 5v5.
Validation-tail calibration selection is optimistic; final 2026 is the only locked final evaluation.
CIs cluster by UTC date and condition on selected models; selection uncertainty is not included.
v6 code unchanged; v6 expanded-data control and original-data control both refit only through 2024.
Conservative outcome availability uses max(2 hours, recorded duration + 15 minutes).
